| File | Responsibility |
|------|----------------|
| [errors.mbt](/home/runner/work/openseek-swe-agi/openseek-swe-agi/tasks/protobuf_run_1/errors.mbt) | `ProtobufError.Malformed` raised for all malformed input |

Streaming is funneled through one `read_exactly` that loops over partial `Reader::read` calls, so varints, fixed-width values and payloads reassemble across arbitrary chunking and truncation mid-value raises. Length payloads and skipped unknown bytes drain through a 4 KiB buffer so a bogus length cannot force a huge allocation. `read_packed` confines its element decoder to a `LimitedReader` window; groups are skipped recursively with a depth bound.

## Key implementation points

- **`Array[Char]` view.** `StringView::get_char` indexes by UTF-16 code unit while `char_length` counts code points; mixing them steps onto lone surrogates. Converting once with `to_array()` keeps every code point — CJK and emoji included — as one element.
- **Terminators.** LF, CRLF (one terminator), and lone CR (suite tolerance) handled locally by `terminator_length`; line breaks inside quotes are copied verbatim.
- **Empty-line semantics.** `""` → zero records; `"\n"` → `[[""]]`; a trailing terminator adds no record; an interior blank line is a record holding one empty field.
- **Rejections.** Unterminated quotes, `"` in an unquoted field, text/space after a closing quote, backslash escapes, and records whose field count differs from the first.
